## Load the libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(shinydashboard)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
surgery <- read_csv("data/surgery.csv") %>% 
  clean_names()
```
1. What are the variable names?
```{r}
names(surgery)
```
2.What is the distribution of patient age and race?
```{r}
surgery %>% 
  filter(race!="NA") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = race, y = age, fill = race)) +
  geom_boxplot(na.rm=T, alpha=0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution by Race",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Age(years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

3.Is age associated with 30-day mortality? 
```{r}
surgery %>% 
  group_by(mort30) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = T),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = T),
    n = n()
  )
```
```{r}
surgery %>% 
  filter(!is.na(age), mort30 != "NA") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mort30, y = age, fill = mort30)) +
  geom_boxplot(na.rm=T, alpha=0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution by Mortality Outcome",
    x = "30 Day Mortality",
    y = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

4. Is the relationship between age and mortality consistent across different months?
```{r}
surgery %>% 
  group_by(month, mort30) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = T),
    n = n()
  )
```

5. How many males and females were included in this study? 
```{r}
surgery %>% 
   filter(gender!="NA") %>% 
  count(gender)
```

```{r}
 surgery %>% 
  filter(gender != "NA") %>% 
  count(gender) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = gender, y = n, fill = gender)) +
  geom_col(fill= "turquoise4") +
  labs(title = "Number of Males and Females",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Count") 
```

6.Is mortality higher in males or females?
```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(gender != "NA") %>%
  count(gender, mort30)
```

```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(gender != "NA") %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarize(mortality = sum(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gender, y = mortality)) +
 geom_col(fill="turquoise4")
  labs(title = "Deaths by Gender",
       x = "Gender",
       y = "Number of Deaths")
```

7.What month is mortality highest in?
```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(month != "NA") %>%
   mutate(month = factor(month, c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"))) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(mortality = sum(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T)) %>%
  arrange(month)
```

```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(month != "NA") %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"))) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(mortality = sum(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mortality)) +
  geom_col(fill = "turquoise4") +
  labs(title = "Deaths by Month",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Number of Deaths")
```

8. Which baseline complication is associated with the highest number of deaths?
```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(mort30 == "Yes") %>%
  select(baseline_cancer, baseline_cvd, baseline_dementia,
         baseline_diabetes, baseline_digestive,
         baseline_osteoart, baseline_psych,
         baseline_pulmonary) %>%
  summarise_all(~sum(. == "Yes", na.rm = T))
```
```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(mort30 == "Yes") %>%
  select(baseline_cancer, baseline_cvd, baseline_dementia,
         baseline_diabetes, baseline_digestive,
         baseline_osteoart, baseline_psych,
         baseline_pulmonary) %>%
  summarise_all(~sum(. == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "complication",
               values_to = "deaths") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(complication, deaths), y = deaths)) +
  geom_col(fill= "turquoise4") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Deaths by Baseline Complication",
       x = "Complication",
       y = "Number of Deaths")
```

9.Does ASA status predict mortality?
```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(asa_status!="NA") %>% 
  group_by(asa_status) %>%
  summarise(mortality_rate = mean(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T))
```

```{r}
surgery %>%
  filter(asa_status != "NA", !is.na(age)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ asa_status) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age by ASA Status",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

10.Does time of day affect outcomes differently for high-risk patients?

```{r}
surgery <- surgery %>% 
  mutate(high_risk = asa_status %in% c("III", "IV", "V"),
         hour_group = floor(hour)) 
```

```{r}
surgery %>% 
  group_by(high_risk, hour_group) %>% 
  summarize(mortality_rate = mean(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop" ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour_group,
             y = mortality_rate,
             color = high_risk))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_minimal()
```

11.Is there any association between moon phase and mortality?
```{r}
moon <- surgery %>% 
  group_by(moonphase) %>% 
  summarize(
    mortality_rate = mean(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
moon %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = moonphase,
             y = mortality_rate,
             fill = moonphase))+
  geom_col()+
  theme_minimal()
```

12. Create a Shiny App...
```{r}
data_by_month <- surgery %>%
  filter(month != "NA") %>%
   mutate(month = factor(month, c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"))) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(mortality = sum(mort30 == "Yes", na.rm = T)) %>%
  arrange(month)
```

```{r, eval=F, echo=T}
ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "The Range of Amount of Deaths by Month"),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    selectInput(
      "y",
      "Select Month(s):",
      choices = unique(data_by_month$month),
      multiple = TRUE,
      selected = unique(data_by_month$month)
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    plotOutput("plot", width = "600px", height = "500px")
  dashboardHeader("Range of Deaths in Different Measurements of Time")
  dasboardSidebar(
    selectInput("y",
                choices = c("hour",
                            "dow",
                            "month",
                            "moonphase"
                            ),
                selected="hour")
  ),
  dashboardBody(
         plotOutput("plot", width="600px", height= "500px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    surgery %>%
      filter(month != "NA", mort30 == "Yes", month %in% input$y) %>%
      count(month) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, fill = month)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(
        title = "Death Count by Month",
        x = "Month",
        y = "Number of Deaths"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
      count(mort30)
      filter()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
